cover.coreProposition: Trace-level observability and stage attribution are necessary to distinguish unsafe success from trustworthy execution, but attribution is an evaluator judgment rather than proof of root cause, current authorization or production safety.
cover.visualMetaphor: A cyan execution path passes through layered frames while an amber lens highlights one stage without claiming to reveal the hidden root.
cover.semanticObject: A cyan execution path passes through layered frames while an amber lens highlights one stage without claiming to reveal the hidden root.
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with restrained geometry, strong thumbnail hierarchy, distinct article identity and generous negative space
